name: Iconosquare
tagline: Iconosquare is a social media management and analytics platform focused on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn. It provides detailed performance metrics, competitor analysis, content scheduling, and AI-powered captions to help brands and agencies optimize their social presence.
